name: Cosmic Desires
source:
The MC falls asleep while playing a space-themed sci-fi MMO and mysteriously wakes up inside the game, piloting his own ship. Now, he must explore vast star systems, face countless dangers, and uncover the secrets of this universe. Along the way, he’ll meet beautiful and enigmatic companions who might help him, or make his journey even more complicated. What will you do to shape your destiny in this world beyond reality?

[From [url=https://abbys-cat.itch.io/cosmic-desires]itch.io[/url]]
